name: Coraza Integrated Technology Berhad
overview: Coraza 今年通过全资子公司 Coraza Systems Malaysia Sdn Bhd 以 1,350 万令吉收购位于 Pulau Pinang 的一幅土地及单层厂房（附两层办公楼），用于扩大营运规模；其余公告主要为季报、股东会议及股份分拆相关事项。
overview_en: Coraza this year, through its wholly-owned subsidiary Coraza Systems Malaysia Sdn Bhd, acquired a piece of land and a single-storey factory with a two-storey office building in Pulau Pinang for RM13.5 million to expand its operating capacity; other announcements were mainly quarterly reports, shareholder meetings and share subdivision matters.

segments.name: 集团 / Group
segments.note: 今年主要事项为收购 Pulau Pinang 的物业以扩大营运规模。
segments.note_en: The main event this year was the acquisition of a property in Pulau Pinang to expand operating capacity.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 全资子公司 Coraza Systems Malaysia Sdn Bhd 以 1,350 万令吉现金收购位于 Pulau Pinang 的一幅土地及单层厂房（附两层办公楼）。
actions.text_en: Wholly-owned subsidiary Coraza Systems Malaysia Sdn Bhd acquired a piece of land and a single-storey factory with a two-storey office building in Pulau Pinang for RM13.5 million cash.
